page_summary:
This section gathers PKD's own mentions of Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? across PKD-authored primary writings in the archive. The catalog records 41 detected title mentions in 6 PKD-authored documents. 

The represented source types here include primary text (30), letters (11). The heaviest source documents are Philip K. Dick on Blade Runner (Starlog Magazine) (17), Selected Stories of Philip K. Dick (8), Claudia Bush Letters (6). 

Nearby language repeatedly turns on blade, runner, film, and adaptation. 

The mention list is organized by source document so readers can move directly from each remark to the underlying text.
